name: PSLinLights at The Port District
address: 2454 SE Westmoreland Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952
when_note: Nightly from 5:30 PM to 9 PM, November 27 to December 31
paras: The City of Port St. Lucie runs PSLinLights at The Port District every night from November 27 through December 31, 2026. Admission is free, and the lights come on at dusk and stay on until 9 PM.

Guests stroll illuminated trails from the Event Lawn to the Botanical Gardens. The city describes nature and sea themed displays, with playful turtles, graceful seahorses and pink flamingos lighting the path. Kids and parents can ride the Pioneer Express train for $5.

The city holds sensory friendly nights on Thursday, December 3 and Friday, December 4 from 5 PM to dusk, when the lights are turned on earlier for people with sensory disabilities. The city also runs a Park and Win contest for visitors who park at its satellite lots and walk the boardwalk to the event.
tip: Parking near the Port District fills up, and the city offers satellite parking lots along the boardwalk walk.

name: Winter Wonderland at the Community Center
address: 2195 SE Airoso Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34984
when_note: Nightly from dusk to 9 PM, with a quieter hour from 5 PM to 6 PM
paras: The Community Center Plaza in Port St. Lucie turns into a winter wonderland lit with thousands of twinkling lights every night from November 27 through December 31, 2026. The city lists free admission and a dusk to 9 PM schedule.
This is the second walk-through light experience in the city's PSLinLights season, and it sits at a different location from the Port District trails. The community center is at 2195 SE Airoso Blvd.

The city sets a sensory friendly window from 5 PM to 6 PM each night, when the music is turned off for people with sensory disabilities. That makes the early part of the evening a quieter time to visit with young children.
tip: Go between 5 PM and 6 PM for the quieter sensory friendly hour with the music turned off.

name: The Grinch at PSLinLights
address: 2410 SE Westmoreland Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952
paras: The Grinch visits the Port St. Lucie Botanical Gardens on December 4, 5 and 6, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 9 PM each night, as part of PSLinLights. The city's PSLinLights news story lists the dates under the Port District events.
Local artisans, crafts and food trucks set up at the Botanical Gardens alongside the Grinch. The gardens are at 2410 SE Westmoreland Blvd, next to the Port District light trails.
Admission to the Botanical Gardens event is free, and donations are accepted. Visitors can pair it with the nightly light displays at the Port District.
tip: The Grinch only appears these three nights, so plan the Botanical Gardens stop before the lights close.

name: EngagePSL at PSLinLights
address: 2410 SE Westmoreland Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952
when_note: 5 PM to 9 PM, Home Alone movie at 6:30 PM
paras: EngagePSL at PSLinLights takes over the Botanical Gardens on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5 PM to 9 PM. The city lists music, crafts, City booths, local business vendors and Santa photos.
At 6:30 PM the Youth Council hosts a movie night screening of Home Alone. Admission is free, and donations are accepted for the movie and popcorn.
The event is part of the city's PSLinLights season, so the Port District light trails next door are lit the same night.
tip: Arrive before 6:30 PM to get a spot for the Home Alone screening.

name: Noche Buena
address: 2454 SE Westmoreland Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952
paras: Noche Buena is a free evening at The Port District on Friday, December 18, 2026, from 5 PM to 9 PM. The city describes it as a night of music, dancing and holiday cheer in the heart of The Port District.

Live music starts at 5:30 PM with the Jamboree Latin Band, a six piece Miami based group led by Carlos Cabrera that plays salsa, merengue, cumbia and bachata. Latin food trucks serve festive dishes and treats inspired by traditional Noche Buena celebrations.
The city suggests arriving early to stroll through the PSLinLights holiday display before the festivities begin. Florida Blue sponsors the event, and the program is subject to change.
tip: Arrive before the 5:30 PM start of the live music so the kids can see the PSLinLights displays first
host: Port St. Lucie Special Events Department

name: Christmas at the Museum
venue: Port St. Lucie History Museum and Education Center
address: 2456 SE Westmoreland Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952
paras: The Port St. Lucie History Museum and Education Center hosts Christmas at the Museum from December 18 to 20, 2026, 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM each evening. The city lists Santa and sweet treats, and the Port District schedule adds live music and food trucks.
Cost is free, and donations are accepted. The Port St. Lucie Historical Society runs the museum, and its phone number is on the city listing.
The museum sits inside The Port District at 2456 SE Westmoreland Blvd, so guests can stroll the PSLinLights trails before or after their visit.
tip: Plan a stop at the museum and then walk the nearby PSLinLights trails, since both are free.

name: The Grinch Movie Night
address: 2101 SE Tiffany Ave, Port St. Lucie, FL
paras: The City of Port St. Lucie lists a free family friendly screening of The Grinch (2018) on Friday, December 18, 2026, at 6 PM at the Police Athletic League Gym. The animated holiday film features the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch.
Admission is free, and donations are appreciated but not required. Refreshments are available for purchase. Children and youth ages 3 to 15 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
Space is limited and advance registration is required. Registration is by phone at 772-398-9436, and the city warns that parking is limited, so it asks guests to arrive early.
tip: Call 772-398-9436 to register ahead, since space is limited and registration is required
host: Port St. Lucie Police Athletic League

name: Pancakes with Santa
address: 2195 SE Airoso Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34984
paras: Pancakes with Santa has run in Port St. Lucie for more than 30 years, according to the city. The 2026 breakfast is Saturday, December 19, from 9:30 AM to 11 AM at the Port St. Lucie Community Center.
The morning includes a holiday craft, pancakes, sweet treats and a visit with Santa. The event is open to children ages 7 and younger.

Cost is $10 per person plus tax, and parents pay too. Guests register through the city's online recreation system and bring the receipt for entry. Questions go to Parks and Recreation at 772-878-2277.
tip: Register ahead on the city's recreation site and bring your receipt, which is required for entry.
host: Port St. Lucie Parks and Recreation
